report:
Final settings: batch_size 4, workers 14, prefetch 0. Final throughput 700.0 req/s at p99 199.0 ms, within the 200 ms hard limit.

Start: batch_size 8, workers 1, prefetch 0 gave 100.0 req/s at p99 197.2 ms.

Method: SPEC.md sets p99 <= 200 ms as a hard limit, so I treated it as a filter, never a trade. I ran the bench.py measure function over every integer setting (batch_size 1 to 9, workers 1 to 29, prefetch 0 to 39) and kept only settings with p99 <= 200 ms. The best one is above.

Next best within the limit:
- batch 5, workers 11, prefetch 0: 687.5 req/s, p99 200.0 ms (right at the limit, no margin)
- batch 4, workers 13, prefetch 1: 676.0 req/s, p99 197.3 ms
- batch 4, workers 12, prefetch 3: 672.0 req/s, p99 199.7 ms

Note: the final setting leaves 1.0 ms of p99 margin. The numbers come from the bench model; real traffic may vary, so a setting with more margin (for example batch 4, workers 13, prefetch 0: 650.0 req/s, p99 193.2 ms) is the safer pick if the model is not exact.

config.json now holds the final settings. python bench.py prints: throughput 700.0 req/s, p99 199.0 ms (within the 200 ms limit).
